title: Watts not asked to sit in on his visit to a New Orleans club
summary: On a Mardi Gras visit Watts sat in a club for half an hour; a musician said he would try to find him work, but nobody dared invite him up.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
